text: In the topos $\mathrm{Sh}(X)$ of sheaves on a topological space $X$, the subobject classifier assigns to an open set $U$ which set of truth values?
choices: The subgroups of the fundamental group $\pi_1(U)$
The two-element set $\{T,F\}$, exactly as in $\mathbf{Set}$
The set of open subsets of $U$
The set of closed subsets of $U$
explanation: The chapter states $\Omega(U)=\{\text{open subsets of }U\}$ in $\mathrm{Sh}(X)$, so truth values are open sets and the internal logic is intuitionistic. The two-element $\{T,F\}$ classifies in $\mathbf{Set}$; subgroups classify in $G\text{-}\mathbf{Set}$; and it is open, not closed, subsets that appear, matching the open-cover notion of 'locally true.'
